title: fix: polish model cards and mobile drawer
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fix pricing ledger dividers to end at the unit content
- Remove the Fish Audio logo background so the waveform mask renders correctly
- Align sidebar controls and reduce the mobile drawer width while preserving header spacing
- Validate with Biome, TypeScript, and pricing tests

gist.headline: Cards, drawers, and waves
gist.blurb: A small grooming session for the dashboard: pricing dividers now know where to stop, Fish Audio's waveform can breathe, and the mobile drawer has learned not to occupy the entire meadow.
gist.summary: Polished the dashboard model UI by ending pricing-ledger dividers at their unit content, removing Fish Audio's logo background for correct waveform masking, and tightening mobile drawer and sidebar-control alignment.
gist.impact: Users get cleaner model cards, a correctly rendered Fish Audio waveform, and a more comfortably sized mobile navigation drawer without losing header spacing.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli tidying a cozy model-card garden: she uses a tiny ruler to trim a divider line precisely beneath a price badge while a retro screen displays a clean, flowing Fish Audio waveform. A compact little drawer/cabinet sits neatly at the side to represent the narrower mobile drawer, with flowers and code-plants reinforcing that this is a careful UI polish pass.
